correctness.rationale: The graph of a partial injection decomposes uniquely into directed paths and cycles. Completed cycle lengths are sums of path vertex-lengths, hence parity equals number of odd paths in each concatenated cycle. The two-color labelled cycle exponential formula yields F=sqrt((1-y+x)/(1-y-x)) and coefficient N(u,v)=u(k-1)! C(2 floor(u/2),floor(u/2))/4^floor(u/2). If u=0<v, impossibility on original carrier and adding one singleton odd path gives exactly v! extensions. Existing even cycles cannot be altered. Exhaustive independent completion enumeration for all 1798 partial injections on n<=5 and one-point factorial checks in 296 cases passed; experiments are supportive only.

value.rationale: A concrete and canonical quantitative baseline for the 2026 odd-extension problem: every possible single-generator partial permutation is classified by an explicit obstruction and exact minimum enlargement, and all same-carrier odd-order extension multiplicities collapse to a two-parameter parity invariant. In the obstructed original-carrier case, exactly one fresh point yields precisely v! extensions. This supplies a structural classification with a natural extension resource and a complete exact spectrum, not merely a small case or an existence restatement.
